assets.title: 激光 AI 浮游炮
assets.detail: Subject: compact autonomous hovering laser gun drones, unmanned, visibly floating, no pilot, no legs, no wheels. Three genuinely distinct variants: A squat armored rectangular sensor head with one red-orange eye and a short underslung laser barrel, two small side stabilizers; B horizontal twin-pod industrial chassis with a narrow slit sensor and protruding forward focusing lens; C angular battered maintenance-drone body converted to a gun, exposed little power cable loop and a single long forward laser emitter. Each has only a tiny blue-white charge pixel inside the barrel, not a long beam. Body about 24-30 native pixels wide and 12-18 pixels tall, smaller than the hero. Make the barrel direction and the sensor instantly recognizable from the side. Hovers with small compact levitation modules, no smoke trail.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: low-resolution enemy sprite concept sheet for the existing Nightwalker 2D side-scrolling industrial wasteland game.
Input images: reference image 1 is the approved game screenshot, used only for palette, industrial mood and the hero-relative sprite detail density; reference image 2 is the existing player sprite, used only for native body proportion and coarse pixel scale. Do not draw the reference screenshot or hero.
Primary request: THREE DISTINCT design variants of ONE enemy type, all in strict right-facing side view, full silhouette, arranged horizontally in three separate equal cells, consistent scale and fixed shared ground line. These are different concept designs, not animation frames.
Style/medium: authentic very low resolution pixel sprite art. Human enemies approximately 28-32 native pixels from boots to head, about 5-6 pixels head height, 8-12 pixels torso width; drone approximately 24-30 pixels wide. Readable clustered shapes, coarse visible square pixels, sparse one-pixel highlights, at most 16 shared visible colors for the designs. Show the native art enlarged by a large whole-number factor so each square pixel is obvious. Small game sprites, never a detailed tall portrait or high resolution illustration.
Color palette: charcoal, desaturated steel gray, grimy olive fabric, dark taupe, rust brown; a small muted amber industrial safety accent. Small hostile red-orange sensor pixels. Warm/cool steel and ochre balance matches the supplied game. No glossy science-fiction white armor, no saturated rainbow neon.
Composition: plain genuinely transparent background, generous transparent margin between the three designs, no floor, no cast shadow, no interface, no landscape. Prefer a wide panoramic sheet. Keep all weapons and costume parts within their own cell, no touching.
Constraints: all full-body side profiles at identical sprite scale; practical worn industrial equipment with a distinct silhouette for each variant. No text, labels, numbers, logo, watermark, painted checkerboard, glow haze, blur, smooth gradient, anti-aliasing, 3D rendering, outlines made of subpixels, tiny high-resolution noise, or oversized chibi heads. Pixel edges must be hard and step-shaped.

assets.title: 轻型外骨骼狙击兵
assets.detail: Class: LIGHT POWERED EXOSKELETON SNIPER. Lean frame, slim mechanical legs and a long scoped rifle aimed right, near body-height length with 1-2px-thick barrel. Three silhouette variants: A small ragged shoulder hood over an exposed spinal rail and an angular narrow eye visor, the cloak short enough to leave thigh/calf actuators visible; B flat low helmet, a forward monocular sight and squared compact battery behind shoulder, long open lower-leg frame; C narrow respirator face, one chipped flat shoulder plate and a short folded camouflage flap, long braced rifle. Light frame and minimal armor compared with assault troops. No large bush camouflage or long robe hiding the machinery.
assets.prompt:

Connected pistons and servo joints must make them recognizably armored human exoskeleton troops rather than ordinary soldiers in a cloth uniform. Practical battered industrial military hardware, chips and rust, no logos.

Draw directly on this extremely coarse sprite grid, show each native square pixel greatly enlarged. Use simple bold clusters and flat stepped 2-3 shade ramps, no tiny surface detailing. Do NOT make a high detail 80px or 150px tall body and call it pixel art. Keep equipment readable after a32px-height downsample. Narrow angular lens1px. Adult proportions matching the hero, not a large boss or chibi figure.
Palette: 12-16 shared colors only, charcoal steel, blue-gray shaded alloy, grimy muted olive, dark taupe, sparse rust brown; tiny amber hazard markings and one red-orange sensor pixel. Industrial exoskeleton could have a little exposed dark frame between armor plates. No smooth white plastic sci-fi armor, no huge neon lights, no decorative chrome.
Composition: only three isolated sprites, no landscape, ground, floor, shadows, UI, text or labels; wide3:1 layout. Crisp hard square pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, glow, gradient, atmospheric halo, painterly detail, blur, 3D rendering or checkerboard. All weapons fit within their cell.

assets.title: 标准外骨骼步枪兵
assets.detail: Class: STANDARD POWERED EXOSKELETON RIFLE GUARD. Stocky shoulder yoke, clear exposed hip/knee frame and compact carbine held aimed right. Three silhouettes: A industrial hard helmet, square chest plate, rectangular backpack cell, standard leg servos; B enclosed narrow visor helmet, asymmetrical shoulder block, skeletal metal forearm, exposed hip rail; C heavy sloped collar armor, angular short faceplate, vented back power module and chunky leg brackets.
